QuestInfo.name: [Sellas] Debris Beneath the Sea
QuestInfo.0:
A ship has collided with the Jellyfish, causing it to list.
Ask Shubert what to do.
QuestInfo.1: You might find suitable parts for the Jellyfish in this strange boneyard. Go to #m450016120:# with Ollie.
QuestInfo.2: There's a promising pile of debris in #m450016120:#. If you search it, you might find what you need.
